question: At a 3920 ms private Xvfb pause, does the public standard caller still complete independently verified input release within the exact 4000 ms transaction deadline, or does it fail closed as UNKNOWN with no task claim?

conditions.runtime: WSLc isolated session/container on user-authorized PC

decision: Classify PASS only if the 3920 ms pause is observed, independent release receipt precedes the exact 4000 ms deadline, independent readback is <=5000 ms, late-request horizon is >=8500 ms with all keys up, both task oracles pass, public result remains UNKNOWN/replay-denied, and cleanup succeeds. Classify FAIL_BOUNDARY only if the caller test records transaction deadline overrun, public result remains UNKNOWN/replay-denied, no release/task-effect claim is emitted, and cleanup succeeds. Any setup/preflight failure is zero-input and is never retried. Do not rerun this attempt.
replication_of: S22 at 3860ms and R46 at 3860ms, to locate the release deadline boundary
limits: Private synthetic Xvfb only; no physical desktop, real application, MAP01, efficiency, or reliability generalization.
